## Quality & Verification Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure the following checks pass cleanly:
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 TypeScript compiler errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit and regression test suites
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly without Next.js / Turbopack build errors
- [ ] Tested responsive layout (mobile and desktop viewports) if UI was modified
